change_notes: Data release v3 = every release v2.2 record copied verbatim (same ids, wording and fields) plus added recipes; ingredients.jsonl is v2.2's 701 ingredients unchanged, so no ingredient id is new (recipe_occurrences still count v2.2's recipes).

Added recipes: the built-but-over-quota v2.1 recipes rebuilt from the v2 staging inputs with the current build rules, and new RecipeNLG (Gathered) candidates never selected in v2 (select_v3_candidates.py); both then take the v2.2 unit-weight corrections (correct_release_v22.correct_recipe), listed in corrections.jsonl.

New candidates qualify only when every line maps to a v2.2 ingredient, every ingredient is priced by the planner rule (backend priceable_ingredients: FairPrice not removed, Cold Storage mapped, curated; no at-home exemption), every ingredient form and unit weight exists, and the triage cuisine is not in the American bucket (american, southern_us, cajun_creole); mains first. Pool lines may resolve through stage-3 alias decisions that land on one of the 701 ids.

New candidates are enriched by the OpenAI API (gpt-5.4-mini, reasoning effort low) with the v2 recipe field set, vocabulary, instructions and validation (enrich_v3_openai.py); this amends ADR-0030's choice of agent sessions. Their records say enrichment.by 'openai/gpt-5.4-mini'.

Not released: an ingredient id outside v2.2, cuisine international (ADR-0034, not relabelled), a completeness-flagged recipe with no review verdict (no new completeness review), implausible energy after the correction, below the importer floor, or a title equal (lower-cased, whitespace-normalised) to one already in the release.
No cuisine label is above 20% of the final total; over a label's room usable courses stay first (main, side, soup, salad, breakfast, then the rest), ties by recipe_id.

Wave 2 (owner 2026-11-02 ~14:45: grow v3 toward 19,000 recipes, medium quality is fine): more new candidates picked by the same rules after the frozen wave-1 picks (v3_selected_wave1.csv), target 18,280 so recipes.jsonl stays under 95,000,000 bytes. Titles are de-duplicated in the order v2.2, over-quota, wave 1, wave 2, and wave 2 only takes the label room the earlier legs leave, so every record of the first v3 build (12,895) stays byte for byte.

Wave 2 enrichment (owner 2026-11-02 ~16:10): part by the OpenAI API (gpt-5.4-mini, as wave 1) until that run stopped, the rest by Claude subagents (enrich_v3_agents.py: the OpenAI enricher's instructions, schema, input and validation); their records say enrichment.by 'claude/<model>'. The OpenAI API is not used for enrichment again.
Composite substitutes ('half-and-half = milk + cream') are not built: the release schema has no field. Open.
Quality targets for the later human checks of the new recipes (issue #392): 'at least 95%' is the point estimate, reported with Wilson 95% intervals.

Two v3 line classes after the v2.2 correction (owner 2026-11-04, issue #426): cooked_rice (cooked, steamed or prepared rice weighed as dry rice moves to the cooked form; a cup is re-weighed at the cooked cup, other amounts keep their grams as an estimate of cooked rice) and package_mass (an estimated counted line takes the package mass its own text states, unless drained, partly used, packed in liquid, cooked or a marinade). A first-build record these change is exempt from the byte-for-byte check; v2.2's records are never changed.
